text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — I noticed sustained growth in kv_resident_bytes on staging-gpu-2 for the last ~90m. Looks correlated with a handful of long chat sessions (seq_len > 8k). dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv

Priya Patel: Oof. Is it actually residency growing or are we leaking pages? can you paste the query you used?

Alex Chen: Query I pulled in Prom: `sum by (pool) (kv_resident_bytes)` and `rate(kv_eviction_total[5m])` showed evictions low while resident bytes climbed.

Jamal Rivers: If evictions are low + resident increasing it smells like fragmented allocations + poor reuse — pages stay resident but not referenced. We should look at `kv_reuse_ratio` and `kv_fragmentation_ratio`. Do we have those exported?

Sasha Ivanov: We recently changed kernel selection to favor fp16 matmul path on that cluster. Could affect cache packing and alignment, possibly changing frag patterns. Also batching heuristics changed (dynamic batching windows) — could produce longer-lived KV allocations in some tail cases. Worth correlating deploy timestamps.

Ciara O'Neill: kv-ops-bot just posted a trace for host staging-gpu-2 at 2198765400 with pprof link: https://artifacts/pprof/2198765400.pb.gz

kv-ops-bot: Alert: kv_residency_growth_rate > 0.5 for 30m on staging-gpu-2 :eyes:

Alex Chen: Notes from quick profiler: saw many small fragments (~4K-16K) not being coalesced; hot set shows repeated single-token writes from long chat sessions. I ran a sampler that shows repeated partial KV writes from the same conversation id.

Priya Patel: Okay. Action items I propose: 1) add/verify `kv_reuse_ratio` (hits / touched) 2) instrument `kv_eviction_age_histogram` to see how long items sit before eviction 3) create a Grafana panel for per-conversation residency 4) add a low-sensitivity alert on kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.2

Jamal Rivers: I can take the sampler + dashboard bits. For queries, I recommend these PromQL snippets to start:```promql
# per-pool resident bytes
sum by (pool) (kv_resident_bytes)

# residency per model
sum by (model) (kv_resident_bytes)

# reuse ratio (approx)
(sum by (pool) (kv_hit_count)) / (sum by (pool) (kv_touch_count) + 1)

# eviction age histogram (exemplar)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(kv_eviction_age_seconds_bucket[10m])))
```

Sasha Ivanov: Also add `kv_page_churn_rate` (pages freed/sec) and `kv_page_alloc_size_histogram` — fragmentation shows up as shift to many small allocs. For the kernel path effect: can we capture per-kernel allocation footprint? If the new kernel uses different blocking, it might create smaller, more frequent KV updates.

Ciara O'Neill: For dashboards, small panels I want: p50/p95 resident bytes, reuse ratio, fragmentation ratio, eviction total rate, eviction_age_p95, per-conversation residency heatmap. I'll mock one in the perf folder and link.

Alex Chen: Quick repro idea: run synthetic long-chat workload with mix of token lengths (1k, 4k, 8k, 12k) and enable the new batching heuristics to reproduce. If we can make it deterministic we can test kernel rollbacks.

Jamal Rivers: I'll spin up a run. Command I'm using for the sampler agent:```bash
kubectl exec -it sampler -- /app/sampler --target staging-gpu-2 --duration 30m --trace --label long-chat
```I'll collect pprof and `kv_churn.log` and upload.

Priya Patel: For alerts, propose two policies:
- warning: kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.15 for 15m (ops)
- critical: kv_residency_growth_rate > 0.4 for 30m + kv_eviction_total < 1/min (oncall)
We don't want noise but we want early detection of slow memory growth.

Alex Chen: We should also add a per-route tag so we can correlate to model+route (customer workloads). Right now metrics are pool/model but not route-aware. That would help root-cause (some routes spam small writes).

Sasha Ivanov: Agree. Adding route label has cost but we can sample labels for heavy hitters. Implementation plan: add a label cardinality cap and only attach `route` when pattern crosses threshold.

Ciara O'Neill: Dashboard mock: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-profiles where I added the heatmap + age histogram + per-route top-n. Please comment.

Alex Chen: TL;DR: root cause hypothesis = fragmentation + low eviction due to reuse checks missing for partial-write patterns caused by batching change. Next steps: Jamal to run sampler + pprof (ETA 2h), Ciara mock dashboard, Priya to add reuse/age metrics, Sasha to correlate kernel/batching deploys. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we confirm. :thumbsup:

Jamal Rivers: Started the sampler run at 2198765450, uploading artifacts to /tmp/kv-sampler-2198765450.tar.gz when done.

Priya Patel: I'll open a metrics PR to add `kv_reuse_ratio` and `kv_eviction_age_seconds_bucket` with tests.

Sasha Ivanov: I'll check deploy history and attach links. Looks like the fp16 kernel rollout hit staging ~2198763000.

kv-ops-bot: Note: automatically created incident ticket INF-723 for "kv residency growth - staging-gpu-2"

Alex Chen: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread and we'll sync at 16:00 if we have artifacts.
